sections.title: Divider line
sections.what: Draws the line and chooses its direction and size.
sections.why: Likely reason: one component handles both directions so the app does not need two copies.
sections.watch_out: A vertical line needs a parent with a set height, otherwise it shows nothing.

summary: Draws a thin dividing line that can be horizontal or vertical.
purpose: Visually separates parts of a page.
why: Likely reason: it wraps a library separator and applies the app's border colour.
how: Chooses a horizontal or vertical line from the orientation setting. A horizontal line is one pixel tall and full width. A vertical line is full height and one pixel wide. Decorative lines are hidden from screen readers by default.
inputs: Orientation and the decorative flag, plus style overrides.
risks: Turning off decorative makes screen readers announce the line, which can add noise.
debug: If no line shows, check the parent gives the line a width or height.
